rules.proposed_specification: For any purchase whose amount is strictly greater than EUR 5,000, Finance approval must be obtained before the purchase order for that purchase is issued.
rules.source_text: A purchase above EUR 5,000 must receive Finance approval before the purchase order is issued.

rules.proposed_specification: For any purchase whose amount is exactly EUR 5,000, Finance approval is not required.
rules.source_text: For a purchase of exactly EUR 5,000, Finance approval is not required.

rules.proposed_specification: For any purchase whose amount is strictly less than EUR 5,000, the department manager is permitted, but not obligated, to approve that purchase.
rules.source_text: For a purchase below EUR 5,000, the department manager may approve it but is not obliged to do so.

rules.proposed_specification: A requester is prohibited, without exception, from approving any purchase request that they themselves submitted.
rules.source_text: A requester must never approve their own purchase request.

rules.proposed_specification: An emergency purchase is exempt from the requirement to obtain competitive quotations.
rules.source_text: An emergency purchase is exempt from obtaining competitive quotations.

rules.proposed_specification: The exemption of emergency purchases from competitive quotations does not exempt an emergency purchase whose amount is strictly greater than EUR 5,000 from the requirement to obtain Finance approval.
rules.source_text: The emergency quotation exemption does not remove the Finance approval requirement above EUR 5,000.

rules.proposed_specification: Finance approval may be provided solely by the Head of Finance, and the buyer is not permitted to provide Finance approval.
rules.source_text: Only the Head of Finance can provide the Finance approval; the buyer cannot provide it.

rules.proposed_specification: If a requester cancels a purchase request before that request has been approved, that same requester is obligated to record the reason for the cancellation.
rules.source_text: If a requester cancels a request before approval, that requester must record the cancellation reason.

rules.proposed_specification: Each approval record must be retained for a minimum of 30 calendar days, and deletion of an approval record before the end of that minimum period is prohibited.
rules.source_text: Approval records must be retained for at least 30 calendar days and cannot be deleted earlier.

rules.proposed_specification: The purchase amount threshold is evaluated individually for each purchase request and is not evaluated against the aggregated monthly total of purchases from a supplier.
rules.source_text: The purchase threshold applies separately to each request, not to the monthly total for a supplier.

rules.proposed_specification: Distinct suppliers are permitted to share the same supplier name, so supplier name must not be treated as a unique identifier of a supplier.
rules.source_text: Different suppliers may have the same supplier name; supplier name is not a unique identifier.

rules.proposed_specification: The retention period for an approval record starts on the date of the approval and does not start on the date of the purchase order.
rules.source_text: The retention period begins on the approval date, not the purchase-order date.
